note: Demo Console presentation + source refs. Scenario names/labels live here — application code applies only generic kinds.

controls.label: Trigger airline disruption
controls.description: Applies the configured disclosed airline cancellation and rebooking through the normal provider-event boundary.

controls.label: D1 — Delay, connection safe
controls.description: Progressive delay stage: connection remains viable above minimum connection time.

controls.label: D2 — Connection at risk
controls.description: Progressive delay stage: connection tight / at risk under MCT pressure.

controls.label: D3 — Connection impossible
controls.description: Progressive delay stage: baseline connection is impossible. Also sets the configured evaluation clock so same-night departures are no longer boardable.

controls.label: Overnight — Advance scenario clock
controls.description: Advances the workspace evaluation clock only. Overnight / boardability must emerge from timing.
